title: Implement blobext-03 server and serve RFC 9404 (sub-epic: Blob/set, get, lookup, convert, upload)
description: No server code exists. -03 behaviour to build in: blobs have no state (Blob/set rejects non-null ifInState with invalidArguments; old/newState null); dataSourceProperties default [blobId, offset, length]; digest names from the RFC 9530 registry, digest:* must be in supportedDigestAlgorithms (else invalidArguments), digest over exactly the returned octets; SetErrors invalidProperties/tooLarge/notFound; optional whole-blob size and digest:* on BlobCreateObject; BlobObject size null until a deferred convert result is generated, failed generation = not found everywhere; ExtractRecipe result id/type/size are the archive's; ArchiveEntry.created; Blob/lookup reference rules restored from RFC 9404 (Mailbox/Thread via Emails, Can Reference Blobs only, no undiscoverable ids).
notes:
Decision Mark 2026-11-12: crate-jmap aims to be THE complete reference implementation covering the JMAP specs, so this is required work, not optional. Split rule: the crates own wire types, validation, method semantics and error mapping; storage-, transport- or media-specific work is pushed to the calling crate through backend trait hooks (see the spec-method-defaults memory: no no-op default when that would put wrong data on the wire). Here: method handling, recipe validation and error mapping in the crates; blob storage, the reverse lookup index, and actual image/media conversion are backend hooks the caller implements.
2026-11-13: design doc docs/design/blobext.md; decisions docs/design/DECISIONS.md. Children in dependency order (note key, id, size, title):
- B0 JMAP-tna1.2.1 [S] blob: scaffold jmap-blob-types, jmap-blob-server, jmap-blob-client
- B2 JMAP-tna1.2.2 [M] blob-types: capability, DigestAlgorithm, BlobRef, DataSourceObject, Blob/set and Blob/get types
- B3 JMAP-tna1.2.3 [M] blob-types: Blob/convert recipes and Blob/lookup types
- B4 JMAP-tna1.2.4 [M] blob-server: BlobBackend trait, register_blob_handlers, mode/range/order helpers
- B5 JMAP-tna1.2.5 [M] blob-server memory backend core
- B6 JMAP-tna1.2.6 [M] blob-server memory conversions: ustar archive/extract, deferred results, stub converter
- B7 JMAP-tna1.2.7 [M] blob-server: Blob/get handler
- B8 JMAP-tna1.2.8 [M] blob-server: Blob/set handler
- B9 JMAP-tna1.2.9 [S] blob-server: Blob/lookup handler
- B10 JMAP-tna1.2.10 [M] blob-server: Blob/convert handler
- B11 JMAP-tna1.2.11 [M] blob-server: serve RFC 9404 urn:ietf:params:jmap:blob (Blob/upload, 9404 Blob/get and Blob/lookup)
- B18 JMAP-tna1.2.12 [S] blob-server: conditional Blob/set via the opt-in registration path
- B19 JMAP-tna1.2.13 [S] testjig: advertise blob2 and blob, register blob handlers
- B23 JMAP-tna1.2.14 [M] blob-server: RFC 8620 §6.3 Blob/copy
2026-11-13: B18 (JMAP-tna1.2.12) depends on conditional C2, C3, C4 (JMAP-y1yu.2, .3, .4), the pieces its description names, not on the whole JMAP-y1yu epic. Its description still says ClosureHandler::new_set; conditional decision 1 replaced that with Dispatcher::attach_set_support and register_<x>_conditional (see docs/design/conditional.md §5.1 and its §12 Q2).
